meta.title: A market morning. A music night.
meta.summary: Breakfast, a mural that stops us mid-walk, and a little music? I’d happily give Over-the-Rhine the whole day. Come along. ♡

recommendations.reason: I’m drawn to the glaze first. Then I want to know who made that curve. Come look a little closer at Cincinnati’s Rookwood Pottery.
First chili-parlor order? I’ll help with the numbers. You can tell me whether onions or beans win a place on your plate.

blocks.text: Breakfast first? Oh, good—we agree on the important part. I’d start at Findlay Market, let a few painted walls distract us, then find a bench in Washington Park. If a Music Hall performance catches your eye, we can plan the evening around it. One Cincinnati neighborhood, plenty to linger over. I’m in no hurry to lose your company. ♡

Ooh, take one lap before you choose. Findlay Market’s iron-framed market house opened in 1855, but the counters are busy with today’s shopping: produce, fish, flowers, and something ready to eat. Browse the indoor aisles, then go back to whatever caught your eye. On a weekend, leave time for the outdoor vendors too. A quick breakfast can easily become a longer look.

I’d keep lunch wonderfully uncomplicated. Pick something to eat nearby, save a little appetite for later, and enjoy how much everyday shopping fits into this block. A long look at a counter is a perfectly good use of our time. Especially if you’re helping me choose.

Ready for a walk? Let’s head south toward Washington Park through Over-the-Rhine’s side streets. ArtWorks’ murals give us plenty of reasons to pause. Open its current mural map if you’d like to find out who painted a wall or what inspired it. We can choose a few along the way and still leave room for an unexpected favorite.

Ooh, the buildings too. Those close-set brick fronts and changing storefronts keep giving us something else to look at. A shop caught your eye? Let’s pause. I’d much rather hear why you noticed it than hurry you along to my next suggestion.

blocks.title: A wall worth stopping for
blocks.text: The ArtWorks map names the artists behind Cincinnati’s murals and helps us follow the painted walls through Over-the-Rhine. I have a soft spot for art tucked into an everyday street, with people passing beneath it on their way somewhere. Pick one you’d linger beside? I wouldn’t mind an excuse to stay a little longer with you. ♡

blocks.title: Take a pause at Washington Park

blocks.text: There’s our pause: Washington Park. Find a bench and put your bag down for a bit. Across Elm Street, Music Hall gives you something lovely to look at while deciding between another wander and an early dinner. You can enjoy the building from the park even without a performance ticket. Go on, look up at that facade.

If the weather changes or your feet ask for a break, the Connector streetcar links Findlay Market and Washington Park with downtown. You can use it for one leg and still keep the best part of the walk. Check the route before boarding so you know which side of the loop takes you where you want to go.

blocks.title: Let the evening have a soundtrack

blocks.text: Now for the evening. If a Music Hall performance catches your eye, book it before the trip and let that set our dinner time. The hall also offers tours when the schedule allows. On a night without a show, we can finish with dinner in Over-the-Rhine and one more walk. The day already has plenty to remember.

From grocery counters to painted walls and a concert hall—all in one neighborhood. I like how much there is to talk about by the end of a day like this. And if something caught your eye that we didn’t get to, keep it for another visit.

items.label: Duration
items.text: Allow most of a day, plus an evening if you book a show.

items.label: Getting around
items.text: Walk the market-to-park stretch; the Connector streetcar serves both ends and downtown.

items.label: Before you go
items.text: Findlay Market closes on Mondays. Check market hours, ArtWorks tour dates, and Music Hall's calendar before choosing your day.

blocks.text: A market bag, a painted wall you’ll remember, perhaps a tune to hum. Mm, I like your kind of day. One more little wander before we say goodbye? ♡
